caption: The drawing depicts a mantel clock with a rounded, gothic-arched top and a rectangular base. The main body of the clock is dark brown or black, decorated with a floral motif including flowers and leaves in shades of pink, yellow, green, blue, and white, emerging from an orange or gold vase positioned below the clock face. The perimeter of the clock, following the arched shape, is outlined with a border of small pastel-colored flowers and leaves. The clock face is circular and centrally positioned near the top half, featuring black Roman numerals and two black clock hands on a cream or light tan background. The lower rectangular base of the clock includes an additional decorative circular compartment, possibly a pendulum window, also bordered and flanked by a similar floral and vine pattern in greens, reds, and yellows. The drawing is rendered on a beige or light tan background and framed with a thin pencil-drawn border. The artist's signature, "Phillips," is visible in the bottom right corner.
title: Clock
